About this hall preview

The original sloped panel, pooja door outlines, doorway and hall arrangement are retained from your three matching SketchUp files. The TV panel uses a glossy white marble-look finish. Brown paneling, louvers and hinged shutters use walnut mica.

The pooja doors have CNC circular, bell and lotus cut-outs inspired by your reference. The TV storage has glass centre doors. The decorative side display has tinted glass, inner glass shelves and warm lighting. The robot-cleaner cabinet has a hinged upper shutter and a clear lower entrance.

Source geometry is retained for comparison under Reference colours. Interior shelves, appliances and CNC artwork are illustrative. Finish choices save in this browser; prices have not been provided.
